scope: Pure offline psm2 kinematic screening for the existing non-anatomical sheet. No FK RPC, collision check, actuation, scene edit, or optical qualification.
direction: Positive psm2 transverse_x from the scene's registered RCM configuration, same world-space translation for the whole specimen.
target_sampling: Both sealed loaded align1 sheets: sample the midpoints of material columns 11 and 12 at rows 0 through 10, plus the 1 mm approach and 3 mm review backoff at the original entry and row 10. Retain the chosen material directions. Evaluate nominal plus +/-0.5 mm deterministic offsets on each of transverse_x, transverse_y, and axis_home independently. Not a simulated noise trial.
screen: Report the literal RCM-to-point ray and a translated calibrated ray carrying the angular offset between matched recorded shaft commands and TCP rays. Use only capture ticks immediately following accepted closed-alignment or cut-advance commands. Calibrated yaw is a sensitivity estimate, not full wrist IK; cross-check spread on each view before reporting margin. Coarse candidate requires all perturbed yaw estimates inside [-2.5,+1.0] degrees and pitch inside unchanged native soft interval; do not promote a ray result to tool-pose, grasp, optics or path feasibility.
